## Professional Summary

Nitesh Yadav is a Senior Frontend Engineer and Frontend Lead with 4+ years of production experience specializing in building scalable, accessible (WCAG 2.1 AA & GIGW 3.0 compliant), high-performance digital platforms across GovTech, FinTech, and enterprise ecosystems.

He spearheads **India's National Design System (UX4G v3.0+)** for the National e-Governance Division (NeGD), Ministry of Electronics & Information Technology (MeitY), Government of India. His work powers digital public infrastructure across central ministries, state government portals, and citizen-facing digital services.

Nitesh is also an early adopter and pioneer of **AI-driven development workflows**, having engineered the official **UX4G Model Context Protocol (MCP) server** and agent skills for Claude Code and Gemini CLI, enabling hallucination-free AI code generation for accessible public user interfaces.

## Core Technical Competencies & Tech Stack

### Frontend Frameworks & Languages
- **Primary Frameworks:** Angular (14–17+ SSR), React.js (18/19), Next.js (App Router, SSR, SSG)
- **Core Languages:** TypeScript (5.4+), JavaScript (ES6+), HTML5, CSS3, SCSS
- **UI & Design Systems:** UX4G Design System, Angular Material, PrimeNG, TailwindCSS, Bootstrap 5, Web Components, Custom 2-Tier Design Token Engine

### State Management & Reactive Programming
- **RxJS:** Advanced reactive pipelines, Observables, Subjects, state management, custom operators
- **Redux / Redux Toolkit:** Normalized state, RTK Query, slices, middleware
- **Angular NgRx / Services:** Facades, signals, reactive state architecture

### Accessibility & Compliance Engineering
- **Standards:** WCAG 2.1 AA / AAA, GIGW 3.0 (Guidelines for Indian Government Websites)
- **Assistive Technologies:** Web Speech API (Text-to-Speech), Screen Reader integration, Focus Management, Keyboard Navigation (tabindex matrix, roving tabindex), Dyslexia-Friendly Typography, Contrast & Saturation controls, Reading Guides & Masks
- **Accessibility Testing:** Axe-core, Lighthouse, WAVE, NVDA, JAWS

### Testing, Quality & Security
- **Unit Testing:** Jasmine, Karma, Jest, React Testing Library (80%+ test coverage standards)
- **Code Quality & Security:** SonarQube quality gates, CERT-In audit compliance, CSP (Content Security Policy), SRI (Subresource Integrity), JWT HTTP Interceptors, Route Guards

### AI & Agentic Development
- **Model Context Protocol (MCP):** Architected and deployed the official UX4G MCP Server
- **AI Agent Skills & CLI:** Custom agent skills and CLI workflows for Claude Code, Gemini CLI, OpenAI Codex, GitHub Copilot

### Build Tools, DevOps & Data Engines
- **Build Tools:** Webpack, Vite, ESBuild, Babel, npm package monorepo architecture
- **DevOps & CI/CD:** Docker containerization, Jenkins pipelines, Git, GitHub, GitLab, Bitbucket, Jira
- **Data Visualization & Export:** ApexCharts, Chart.js, jsPDF, pdf-lib, html2canvas, SheetJS (XLSX)

## Flagship Projects & Impact

### 1. JNARDDC National Stakeholders Portal
- **Client / Ministry:** Ministry of Mines, Govt. of India
- **Role:** Senior Angular Developer
- **Tech Stack:** Angular 17, TypeScript 5.4, RxJS, Angular Material, Chart.js, Jasmine, Karma, Bootstrap 5, Docker
- **Live URL:** https://nfmrecycling.jnarddc.gov.in/
- **Key Contributions & Architecture:**
  - Architected an Angular 17 enterprise platform integrating 3 portals (Citizen, Admin, and CMS Portal) into a single unified codebase.
  - Built dynamic multi-step onboarding & NCMM incentive forms with Reactive FormArrays and reusable component architecture.
  - Engineered Green Rating audits, Admin approval dashboards, and CMS Portals.
  - Wrote Jasmine/Karma unit test suites (80%+ coverage) and optimized 20+ lazy-loaded modules, slashing bundle load times by 40%.

### 2. UX4G Design System
- **Organization:** NeGD, Ministry of Electronics & IT (MeitY), Govt. of India
- **Role:** Frontend Lead
- **Project Scope:** India's national design system standardizing accessible, citizen-first UI across public digital platforms.
- **Live Docs:** https://doc.ux4g.gov.in/
- **Key Contributions & Architecture:**
  - Spearheaded UX4G (v3.0+), delivering a 100% GIGW 3.0 & WCAG 2.1 AA UI foundation adopted across central ministries, state portals, and public infrastructure.
  - Authored comprehensive Storybook documentation covering 57 UI components, 66 citizen patterns across 9 domains, and 8 service pattern flows with code for HTML, React, and Angular.
  - Built the official UX4G Model Context Protocol (MCP) server and agent skills for Claude Code and Gemini CLI for automated, zero-hallucination UI generation.
  - Architected multi-framework monorepo publishing tree-shakeable npm packages backed by a 2-tier design token engine (1,148 tokens) with native dark mode and regional theming.

### 3. UX4G Accessibility Tool
- **Organization:** NeGD, Ministry of Electronics & IT (MeitY), Govt. of India
- **Role:** Frontend Developer
- **Live URL:** https://www.ux4g.gov.in/ (CDN: cdn.ux4g.gov.in)
- **Key Contributions & Architecture:**
  - Developed India's plug-and-play Accessibility Widget (v1.0–v3.26), distributed via CDN (`cdn.ux4g.gov.in`), supporting accessibility across government portals.
  - Engineered floating accessibility launcher, modal drawer, customizable Grid/List views, and reusable UI components.
  - Implemented Screen Reader using Web Speech API (Text-to-Speech), Reading Guide, Reading Mask, and Focus Mode.
  - Developed visual accessibility controls including Dark Mode, Invert Colors, Monochrome, High/Low Saturation, and Contrast Adjustment.
  - Implemented Text Resizing, Line Height, Letter Spacing, Dyslexia-Friendly Fonts, and Big Cursor functionality.
  - Integrated Highlight Links, Hide Images, Pause Animations, Voice Support, and keyboard navigation across HTML, JavaScript, React, and Angular.
  - Contributed to accessibility improvements aligned with WCAG 2.1 AA and GIGW 3.0 guidelines.

### 4. UX4G Automated UX (Audit360 Platform)
- **Organization:** NeGD, Ministry of Electronics & IT (MeitY), Govt. of India
- **Role:** Frontend Developer
- **Tech Stack:** Angular 16, TypeScript, RxJS, Node.js, Express, Angular Material, Bootstrap 5, ApexCharts, jsPDF, html2canvas, Karma/Jasmine, Docker, SonarQube
- **Live URL:** https://audit360.ux4g.gov.in/onboarding
- **Key Contributions & Architecture:**
  - Engineered a web platform to automate UX, web performance, and compliance audits for government portals against GIGW (Guidelines for Indian Government Websites) and WCAG accessibility standards.
  - Architected responsive dashboards and audit workflows using Angular 16, RxJS state management, and ApexCharts for interactive visual analytics and scoring.
  - Integrated RESTful APIs and real-time sockets to orchestrate single/multi-URL Lighthouse audits, compliance evaluations, and automated viewport screenshots.
  - Implemented client-side PDF export engines using jsPDF, pdf-lib, and html2canvas for dynamic, multi-page audit report downloads.
  - Maintained enterprise-grade code quality and security using SonarQube gates, Karma/Jasmine unit tests, and Docker containerization.

### 5. BranchX Fintech
- **Company:** Antino Labs
- **Role:** Frontend Software Developer
- **Domain:** FinTech
- **Tech Stack:** React, TypeScript, Redux, Dashboards, FinTech APIs
- **Key Contributions & Architecture:**
  - Built comprehensive multi-role admin, merchant, and vendor interfaces with real-time analytics dashboards.
  - Engineered live transaction monitoring pipelines and automated financial settlement reporting (50K+ monthly transactions processed).
  - Implemented strict role-based access control (RBAC) and performance optimizations reducing bundle size by 40%.
